user.title: Select Vehicle
user.description: Choose the device tracker that provides your car's GPS location.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Fine-tune when the integration re-resolves the parking schedule.

data_description.movement_threshold: Min distance the car must move before re-running the schedule lookup. 50 m filters GPS drift without missing real moves.
data_description.refresh_interval: Re-check schedule even without movement so upcoming windows stay current. 8 h balances freshness with API calls.
data_description.stale_timeout: Mark sensor unavailable after this long without a GPS update. Match your tracker's reporting frequency.

api_keys.title: NYC 311 API Key (Optional)
api_keys.description: Enter your NYC 311 API key to receive weather and emergency suspension alerts. Leave blank to skip — holiday suspensions still work without it.

data_description.nyc311_api_key: Get a free key at api-portal.nyc.gov. Enables real-time weather/emergency suspension detection.

error.invalid_api_key: Invalid API key — check your NYC 311 API portal subscription key.

abort.already_configured: ASP Parking Monitor is already configured.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Fine-tune when the integration re-resolves the parking schedule.

data_description.movement_threshold: Min distance the car must move before re-running the schedule lookup. 50 m filters GPS drift without missing real moves.
data_description.refresh_interval: Re-check schedule even without movement so upcoming windows stay current. 8 h balances freshness with API calls.
data_description.stale_timeout: Mark sensor unavailable after this long without a GPS update. Match your tracker's reporting frequency.
data_description.nyc311_entity: Leave empty for auto-detection. Only set this if you renamed the ha-nyc311 binary sensor.
data_description.nyc311_api_key: Get a free key at api-portal.nyc.gov. Leave blank to disable 311 polling.
data_description.notify_service: Pick a notify service. Leave empty to disable push notifications. If the list is empty, set up the Home Assistant Companion app or another notify integration first.
data_description.notify_lead_time: How many minutes before a cleaning window starts to send the push notification. Default 120 minutes (2 hours). Range 15-480.

debug.title: GPS & Time Overrides
debug.description: Override GPS coordinates and datetime for testing. Leave blank to use live device data.

data_description.debug_lat: Fake GPS latitude for testing. Both lat and lon must be set together.
data_description.debug_lon: Fake GPS longitude for testing. Both lat and lon must be set together.
data_description.debug_datetime: Replace the current date/time for schedule and suspension checks.
data_description.suppress_notifications: When enabled, push notifications are silenced while debug overrides are active. Prevents test runs from sending alerts to your phone.

parking_area.title: Parking Area (Optional)
parking_area.description: Define a home parking zone so the integration can pre-fetch sign data for nearby blocks. Leave all fields blank to use on-demand lookups only.

data_description.parking_lat: Latitude of your usual parking area (e.g. copy from Google Maps).
data_description.parking_lon: Longitude of your usual parking area.
data_description.parking_radius: How far around the center to pre-fetch sign data, in meters. Larger radii pre-fetch more blocks but make more API calls to NYC Open Data. For radii above 1000 m, a NYC Open Data app token is recommended to avoid rate limits (set via the NYC_OPEN_DATA_APP_TOKEN environment variable on your HA host).

error.invalid_api_key: Invalid API key — check your NYC 311 API portal subscription key.

gps2asp_import_error.title: ASP Parking: vendored package is incomplete
gps2asp_import_error.description: The bundled gps2asp Python package is missing files. Reinstall ASP Parking from HACS to restore them, then reload the integration. After a successful reload, this notification clears automatically.
